name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefit: Direct income support paid straight into your bank account in three equal instalments each year.
applySteps: Register online on the PM-KISAN portal (New Farmer Registration) with your Aadhaar, or visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Your state checks your land records before payments start.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefit: Cashless hospital treatment at empanelled government and private hospitals for your whole family.
applySteps: There is no application form. Check whether your family is on the list at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or in the Ayushman app, then get your free Ayushman card at a Common Service Centre (CSC) or the Ayushman desk of any empanelled hospital.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
benefit: Financial assistance to build a permanent house if you currently live in a kutcha or damaged home.
applySteps: You cannot apply with a form. Households are chosen from government survey lists (SECC 2011 and Awaas+) and approved by the Gram Sabha. Ask your Gram Panchayat whether your household is on the list.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
benefit: Interest subsidy on a home loan for buying or building your first house in a town or city.
applySteps: Apply online on the PMAY-Urban 2.0 portal with your Aadhaar, or ask at your city or town municipal office.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: A high-interest savings account for a girl child, with tax-free returns at maturity.
documents: Birth certificate of the girl child
applySteps: Open the account at any post office or authorised bank with the girl's birth certificate and a parent's Aadhaar and PAN. Form-1 is the official account-opening form.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
benefit: A free LPG gas connection with the deposit waived, so you no longer have to cook on firewood.
applySteps: Fill the Ujjwala KYC form and submit it at your nearest LPG distributor (Indane, HP Gas or Bharat Gas) with your Aadhaar and ration card. You can also apply online on pmuy.gov.in.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
benefit: A collateral-free business loan to start or grow a small non-farm enterprise.
applySteps: Apply at any bank, regional rural bank, small finance bank or microfinance lender, or online on the Udyami Mitra portal. Most lenders accept the common MUDRA loan application form.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship (SC/ST/OBC)
benefit: Covers tuition fees plus a monthly maintenance allowance for studies after Class 10.
benefitAmount: Full tuition + up to ₹1,200 per month
applySteps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal, or your state's scholarship portal, using your One Time Registration (OTR) number made with Aadhaar. Check your state's last date.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefit: A guaranteed monthly pension after you turn 60, funded by small monthly contributions now.
applySteps: Join at the bank or post office where you have a savings account, or through net banking. Submit the APY registration form; your monthly contribution is auto-debited.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefit: Accident insurance cover for death or permanent disability, at a premium of ₹20 a year.
applySteps: Enrol at the bank or post office where you have a savings account, or through net or mobile banking. The ₹20 premium is auto-debited once a year.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefit: Life insurance cover for your family, at a premium of ₹436 a year.
applySteps: Enrol at the bank or post office where you have a savings account, or through net or mobile banking. The ₹436 premium is auto-debited once a year.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
benefit: Cash support during pregnancy for your first living child, to make up for lost wages.
applySteps: Register through your nearest Anganwadi worker or health centre, or online on the PMMVY portal, soon after your pregnancy is registered.

name: Stand-Up India
benefit: A bank loan to set up a new manufacturing, services or trading business.
applySteps: Register on the Stand-Up India portal and choose up to 3 banks, or apply directly at a bank branch or through your district's Lead District Manager.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
benefit: Skill training with a daily stipend, a toolkit grant, and a collateral-free loan for traditional artisans.
applySteps: Register free at your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with your Aadhaar and mobile number. Your Gram Panchayat or town office checks your trade before approval.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
benefit: A monthly pension paid to elderly people from below-poverty-line households.
applySteps: Apply at your Gram Panchayat (villages) or municipal office (towns) with proof of age, your BPL card and photos. Some states also accept applications online or through the SAMBAL app.
